Support our managers: Be a trusted People partner, providing practical HR guidance and coaching to managers and senior stakeholders. Keep us compliant: Stay ahead of UK employment law and regulatory changes, ensuring our policies, processes and manager guidance remain current and effective. Strengthen our culture: Drive engagement and find creative ways to strengthen connection and cross-functional collaboration across our remote-first team. Manage core People operations: Oversee HiBob, payroll alongside Finance and our external provider, benefits, remuneration, employee records and People reporting. Oversee Talent Acquisition: Manage and support our small recruitment team, recruitment budget and processes, including Ashby. Deliver and improve: Execute our People roadmap, manage operational People risks and lead practical improvements to our HR processes and employee experience. Explore AI in HR: Identify practical and creative opportunities to use AI to make our People processes more efficient and effective. Support business growth: Work closely with the COO and Finance on headcount planning and workforce budgeting, alongside supporting People-related requirements for a potential investment round. What We’re Looking For You’ll be an experienced HR generalist who is comfortable operating independently across a broad People remit. You’ll combine strong HR knowledge with practical judgement, empathy and the confidence to work with stakeholders at all levels. You’ll bring: Strong generalist HR experience within a fast-paced, changing environment. Hands-on experience managing the full employee lifecycle and employee relations. Strong working knowledge of UK employment law and HR best practice. Experience supporting managers with probation, absence and performance management. Confidence advising and coaching managers and senior stakeholders. Experience managing core HR operations, including HR systems, payroll, benefits and employee records. Experience delivering employee engagement, culture or HR improvement initiatives. A proactive, organised approach and the ability to manage competing priorities independently. Sound judgement and a practical, solutions-focused approach to complex People situations. Comfort working with ambiguity and adapting when business priorities change.
